title: Prediction Aggregation Utilities
summary: This module provides functions to aggregate multiple predictions, primarily by selecting the majority completion for a given field. It includes utilities for normalizing text to ensure robust comparison during the aggregation process.

nodes.label: Aggregate Predictions by Majority
nodes.title: Majority Aggregation
nodes.description: Selects the most common completion for a specified field across multiple predictions, handling ties by prioritizing earlier completions. It can operate on Prediction objects or raw lists of completions.

nodes.label: Normalize Text for Comparison
nodes.title: Default Normalization
nodes.description: Provides a default text normalization function, typically used to clean strings before comparison for aggregation. It wraps an external utility for actual normalization.

nodes.label: Standard Text Normalization
nodes.title: Text Normalization Utility
nodes.description: An external utility function (likely from `dspy.utils`) that performs general text cleaning and normalization, often used for robust string comparisons by removing inconsistencies.

nodes.label: Input Prediction Object
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.description: Represents a single prediction output from a DSPy module, potentially containing multiple completions that need to be aggregated.

nodes.label: Input Completions List
nodes.title: DSPy Completions List
nodes.description: A list of raw completions, often extracted from a Prediction object, used as an alternative input format for the aggregation function.

nodes.label: Aggregated Prediction Output
nodes.title: Aggregated DSPy Prediction
nodes.description: The final Prediction object containing the single, aggregated completion chosen by the majority voting mechanism after processing multiple inputs.

groups.label: Prediction Aggregation Logic
groups.title: Core Aggregation

groups.label: Normalization Utilities
groups.title: Text Preprocessing
groups.description: Helper functions for standardizing text data before comparison, ensuring consistent and robust aggregation results.

groups.label: Data Structures
groups.title: Input/Output Data
